title: Gen Z Burnout Risk Classification with Neural Networks
subtitle: Multiclass neural network classification on tabular behavioral data
description: Deep learning project focused on multiclass classification of burnout risk in Gen Z using lifestyle, mental wellness and digital behavior variables, with class weighting and macro-metric evaluation.
highlights: Built a supervised multiclass classification pipeline for Burnout_Risk with Low, Medium and High classes.
Applied stratified train-validation-test splitting, z-score scaling, one-hot encoding and class weighting.
Compared linear softmax, shallow neural network, Keras Tuner and deeper MLP configurations.
Selected the final model using validation macro F1 and evaluated it with accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy and confusion matrices.
Reported a final test accuracy of 0.998 and macro F1 of 0.9986 for the selected deep MLP configuration.
Documented the strong class imbalance and interpreted the Low class carefully due to its small test support.
